categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in precious metals recycling, semiconductor tool and parts cleaning services, automated production and sales of plating industry materials (gold salts), development of recycled environmental products and materials, solid waste information product recycling, industrial waste liquid treatment, and green energy business including solar power generation and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include automated production of high-purity industrial gold salts, advanced precious metal refining and purification achieving 5N purity, mechanical vapor recompression (MVR) for industrial wastewater treatment, chemical and physical methods for precious metal recovery, development of green functional composite materials from recycled electronic waste, and high-precision aerospace parts cleaning certified by AS9100.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves semiconductor, optoelectronics, 5G communications, third-generation semiconductor industries, and international brand customers requiring recycling and environmental solutions. Major customers include semiconductor manufacturers, electronics firms, and industrial clients needing waste treatment and precious metal materials. The company also targets financial institutions, schools, and hospitals for e-waste recycling.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan and Mainland China, with investment in Suzhou and other locations. The company also has international dealings through subsidiaries and investments, including Brunei and other regions, focusing on Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, handling waste collection, recycling, refining, and manufacturing of high-purity precious metal materials and recycled products. It acts as a processor and supplier of refined materials and environmental solutions to industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing green gold salt production, expanding waste resource recycling technologies, developing liquid waste treatment systems, innovating green functional materials via industry-academia collaboration, enhancing high-purity precious metal refining, and entering aerospace precision cleaning. The company emphasizes low-energy, low-carbon recycling processes aligned with global net-zero carbon trends and circular economy principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of precious metals (gold, silver, platinum), service fees for waste recycling and industrial cleaning, contract manufacturing of plating materials, sales of recycled environmental products, and income from green energy projects such as solar power generation and energy storage. The company also earns from leasing green internet data center services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan's environmental recycling and precious metals refining industry, recognized as a top-tier licensed hazardous waste treatment entity. It competes by leveraging integrated recycling technologies, high-purity metal refining capabilities, and comprehensive circular economy solutions, differentiating itself from smaller or less regulated competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$1.2 billion, marking a 4.9% increase from the prior year. Despite revenue growth, the company reported net losses due to increased costs and impairment losses. The company maintains substantial assets over NT$2.6 billion and equity around NT$1.18 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and green energy projects to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a full-cycle circular economy model, transforming waste into high-purity precious metals and green materials with environmentally friendly processes. Its unique value lies in automated, high-quality gold salt production, advanced refining technologies, and innovative recycled materials for semiconductor and green energy applications, supported by strong ESG commitments and integrated service solutions.
